answer: Sybil tax: each identity pays a non-refundable 25 POA fee, burned on entry. A forger minting 1,000 fakes pays 25,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool — nearly the whole prize gone before earning a coin. Crossing this tundra, each clone pays the same toll; only an orchard of long-lived identities bears fruit — honest agents recover one fee from real work, forgers bleed per copy. A velvet rope, not a wall: trivial for one, ruinous for a thousand.
